name: 57401 · Aberdeen, SD
findings: ZIP 57401 (Aberdeen) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57401 (Aberdeen) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 57401 (Aberdeen) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.2 times the typical level).
